recalls.summary: 2020 Mustang IPMA misaligned at plant; Ford 20S26.
recalls.evidence: Part 573 & dealer letter: 2020 Mustang, Flat Rock builds Feb 10-11 2020 only; no trim/engine restriction stated. GT500 in production then, so VIN-dependent.

Dealer supplement (Safety Recall 20S52, Oct 14 2020): 'GT500 vehicles equipped with a 7-speed dual clutch auto/manual transmission have been added to this program.' Builds Feb 28 2019-Aug 13 2020. All 2020 GT500 are DCT; still VIN-specific.

recalls.evidence: Builds Sep 15 2022-Apr 5 2023 (late 2022MY); no trim restriction stated. Only late-built 2022 GT500 could be in range.

Builds Aug 23-Sep 21 2021, body ALL; no trim restriction.

recalls.component: SYNC 3.2 R10 RC1 software rearview camera
recalls.evidence: Affects Mustangs with SYNC 3.2 R10 RC1 software (4,364 Mustangs), builds May 14 2018-Apr 5 2023; depends on software state, not trim.
